notes: HOTFIX on top of 2.29.1, nothing else changed. When the AI needs a moment, the engineer now first says a short line like Copy, let me check that - so you know he heard you (all 29 languages, same voice). Ask him something he cannot answer twice in a row and he no longer repeats the same status, he just says he cannot tell you anything about that right now (a status question always gets the status). Le Mans Ultimate and rF2 practice and qualifying: the slower car ahead / car behind calls now use the real distance to cars that are actually out on track - before they followed the timing screen and talked about cars sitting in the garage. If your Google AI key project runs out of prepaid credit, the app now tells you plainly instead of promising it will be back in a minute. If the offline speech recognition stops responding, PitWise now restarts it on its own. The iRacing map and coach from 2.29.1 stay on.
